The reference app for the shape + slot pattern: one StarCi app whose front end demonstrates connected and pure components, independent API slots, and a send form.

## Overview

An app repo following HFS (`hfs: 3`, `kind: app`, full edition): a scaffolded `be/` side (Nest, `core` + `cli`, `primary` connection) and the hand-written `fe/apps/shape-slot` source, the slot-teaching fixture the grammar and the knowledge read. The implemented FE layers are listed below; `starci-fe/*` lint and `starci app check` are the two gates proving this sample correct. The back end demonstrates health probes and a notes database; it does not implement the sales REST APIs shown by the front end.

## Stack

Next.js 16, React 19, SWR, react-hook-form + zod, next-intl, `@starci/grammar`, `@starci/eslint-canon-fe`; the be side is the scaffold's Nest skeleton.

## Repository layout

```text
hfs.json                                       app declaration: core API, cli and shape-slot FE
.starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml           hosted analysis declaration
.starcistacks/dev/README.md                     manual host-development runbook
.starcistacks/dev/runtime/env/KEYS.md            names-only environment roster
.starcistacks/dev/seeds/                        idempotent notes seed
be/apps/                                       core and cli entry points and typed environment readers
be/src/features/                               health and notes features
be/src/modules/                                domain and platform modules
fe/apps/shape-slot/src/app/                     Next routes and error boundaries
fe/apps/shape-slot/src/proxy.ts                 next-intl locale selection
fe/apps/shape-slot/src/features/                connected and pure pages and layouts
fe/apps/shape-slot/src/components/              blocks, composites, branches and leaves
fe/apps/shape-slot/src/hooks/                   SWR, form and slot hooks
fe/apps/shape-slot/src/modules/                 API, config, i18n, routes and types
```

The root files (`.husky/`, `.github/workflows/`, `sonar-project.properties`, `codecov.yml`, the `.gitignore` block, the side tool configs) are generated by `starci app sync`; `.editorconfig`, `.nvmrc`, `.gitattributes` and `.github/dependabot.yml` are managed as well. This teaching fixture has no declared Compose, Swarm or Kubernetes runtime and no rendered deployment model. Its `.starcistacks/dev` folder holds a manual host-development runbook, key roster and seed; a deployment requires an operator-authored stack declaration and rendered model.

## Development

Supply the keys listed in [the dev key roster](.starcistacks/dev/runtime/env/KEYS.md) before running the processes. Follow [the dev runbook](.starcistacks/dev/README.md) for the externally supplied PostgreSQL connection, migrations, seeds and probes. `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` must point to the separate sales API used by the FE teaching fixture.

```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck     # tsc over both sides: 0 errors
npm run lint          # eslint-canon-fe + eslint-canon-be, including the shape-slot law: 0 errors
npm test              # the be unit suite
npm run build:be      # nest build of be/apps/{core,cli}
npm run build:fe      # next build of fe/apps/shape-slot (needs NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL)
npx starci app check         # starci app check: 0 errors
```

The core API exposes `/health/live` from local process state and `/health/ready` from a real primary database query. Readiness returns 503 on a connection failure or after its one-second response deadline; the live route remains independent of the database. Its Dockerfile probes `/health/live`. API middleware and Next response headers set HSTS, nosniff, frame restrictions, referrer policy and CSP; the framework response header is disabled. Direct host development trusts zero proxy hops; set `HTTP_SECURITY_TRUST_PROXY` to the known hop count only when every request takes that proxy path.

## Work

The product's Work records live in `.starciwork`.

## Two axes

- **shape** (`state`): the shape of the interface. Each value is one drawing.
- **slot**: the data of one API. Each slot has its own status: `isLoading`, `isForbidden`, `isError` or empty.
  Status renders by formula (`fe/apps/shape-slot/src/components/composites/SlotView`) and is never drawn.

## Names in the sample

| Layer  | Connected (`*/index.tsx`, exported outward) | Pure (`*/component.tsx`, drawn and audited) | Type                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Page   | `OperatePage`                               | `OperatePageBase`                           | `OperatePageProps`, `OperatePageBaseProps`, `OperatePageState`                                                                 |
| Layout | `WorkspaceLayout`                           | `WorkspaceLayoutBase`                       | `WorkspaceLayoutProps`, `WorkspaceLayoutBaseProps`, `WorkspaceLayoutData`                                                      |
| Block  | `HandoffBlock`                              | `HandoffBlockBase`                          | `HandoffBlockProps`, `HandoffBlockBaseProps`, `HandoffStatus`, `HandoffBlockData`, `HandoffBlockActions`, `HandoffBlockLabels` |

`WorkspaceLayout` resolves labels and forwards the router's children. It has no state type: `WorkspaceShell` CSS selects wide or compact navigation. `HandoffBlock` owns the send session and composes the pure `SendHandoffForm` composite through `HandoffBlockBase`. The form draws its `form` or `confirm` state in `DrawerBranch`; `useSendHandoffForm` owns react-hook-form + zod validation and the send mutation.

The component export conventions and the sample's REST hook names are:

- Use only `export const X = …`, no `export default`.
- The only exception is the Next route file: `const Page = …` then `export default Page`.
- SWR reads use `useGetHandoffSwr`, `useGetOrderSwr` and `useGetSendAttemptsSwr`, each in a matching file under `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/hooks/swr/api/rest/queries/`. For example, `useGetHandoffSwr` takes `UseGetHandoffSwrParams` and uses QUERY_HANDOFF_SWR_KEY.
- The SWR write is `usePostSendHandoffSwr`, in its matching file under `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/hooks/swr/api/rest/mutations/`; it uses MUTATE_SEND_HANDOFF_SWR_KEY and takes `SendInput` as the mutation trigger's argument.

## Layers

| Layer     | Folder                                 | In the sample                                                                                                                                                                                           | Shape                                       | Calls API                                           |
| --------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Route     | `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/app/[locale]/` | `[workspaceId]/layout.tsx`, `[workspaceId]/operate/[handoffId]/page.tsx`                                                                                                                                | –                                           | no                                                  |
| Page      | `features/pages/<Name>/`               | `OperatePage`                                                                                                                                                                                           | `view` / `edit`                             | no; only composes Blocks from atoms                 |
| Layout    | `features/layouts/<Name>/`             | `WorkspaceLayout`                                                                                                                                                                                       | shell CSS selects wide / compact navigation | no                                                  |
| Block     | `components/blocks/<Name>/`            | `HandoffBlock` (2 slots + send session), `SendHistoryBlock` (1 slot), `ModuleNavBlock`, `WorkspaceHeaderBlock`                                                                                          | e.g. `prepared` / `sent` / `returned`       | `HandoffBlock` and `SendHistoryBlock` use SWR hooks |
| Branch    | `components/branches/<Name>/`          | `DrawerBranch`, `OrderDisclosure`                                                                                                                                                                       | no                                          | no; only internal interaction                       |
| Composite | `components/composites/<Name>/`        | `OrderSummary`, `SlotView`, `SendHandoffForm`                                                                                                                                                           | `SendHandoffForm`: `form` / `confirm`       | no; the form receives resolved input and actions    |
| Leaf      | `components/leaves/<Name>/`            | `MoneyText`, `StatusChip`                                                                                                                                                                               | no                                          | no                                                  |
| Hook      | `hooks/<domain>/`                      | `swr` (`api/rest/{queries,mutations}`: one SWR hook per REST call), `rhf` (`useSendHandoffForm`), `slot` (`useSlotLabels`)                                                                              | –                                           | goes through `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/modules/`      |
| Module    | `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/modules/`      | `api` (`fe/apps/shape-slot/src/modules/api/rest/client/axios.ts` is the one axios instance; `rest/sales/*.ts` is one typed call each, validated by its zod schema), `config`, `i18n`, `routes`, `types` | –                                           | is the transport layer                              |

## Rules (`starci-fe/*` lint catches them automatically)

| #   | Rule                                                                                                                                                                                            | Lint rule                      |
| --- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| 1   | `*/component.tsx` accepts only `{ state, props, on }`:<br>- `props` are atoms;<br>- `on` is a function whose parameters are atoms;<br>- only Layout additionally accepts the router `children`. | `base-props-atom`              |
| 2   | Only the `*/index.tsx` in the same folder (and the spec) may import `*/component.tsx`. `*/index.tsx` does not re-export `XBase`.                                                                | `base-import-pair`             |
| 3   | `XState` lists only shapes. It must not have `pending` / `loading` / `failed` / `empty` / `closed` / …                                                                                          | `no-data-status-shape`         |
| 4   | A Block's `*/component.tsx` does not branch on `isLoading` / `isError` / `isForbidden` itself; every slot goes through `SlotView`.                                                              | `slot-status-through-slotview` |
| 5   | `XBase` takes `XBaseProps`; `X` takes `XProps`.                                                                                                                                                 | `public-component-signature`   |
| 6   | No Vietnamese text in source; display text lives in `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/modules/i18n/messages/`.                                                                                            | `no-second-language-in-source` |

Besides the lint rules above, the pattern has these conventions; an Overlay is a possible pattern layer, and this sample implements its send form as a Composite:

- Data status (including 403) is tracked per slot, that is per API, and only Blocks have it. Page, Layout and Overlay have no data status.
- The 404 route is handled by `notFound()`.
- A Block whose shape depends on a loading slot uses an `xDefaultState` for its skeleton; this sample exports `handoffBlockDefaultState` from `fe/apps/shape-slot/src/components/blocks/HandoffBlock/component.tsx`.
